class.name: IfcPipeSegment
class.brief_description: A pipe segment is used to typically join two sections of a piping network. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcPipeSegment defines the occurrence of any pipe segment; common information about pipe segment types is handled by IfcPipeSegmentType . The IfcPipeSegmentType (if present) may establish the common type name, usage (predefined type), properties, materials, ports, composition
